title: Use of payments received by a supplying public procurement unit.
bodyText: All payments from any public procurement unit or external procurement unit received by a public procurement unit supplying personnel or services shall be available to the supplying public procurement unit as authorized by law.
bodyHtml: §103D-807  Use of payments received by a supplying public procurement unit.  All payments from any public procurement unit or external procurement unit received by a public procurement unit supplying personnel or services shall be available to the supplying public procurement unit as authorized by law. [L Sp 1993, c 8, pt of §2; am L 1998, c 11, §12]
